jobs.occupation: Systemarchitect (f/m/d) Cybersecurity for Products & Solutions (Ingenieur/in - Systems Engineering)
jobs.description: As System Architect (f/m/d) for Product and Solution Security (PSS) you will lead international teams in driving the full application lifecycle to deliver secure, future-proof system architectures - your technical expertise in cybersecurity will come to life in our products and systems. Certifications in embedded systems or software architecture are a plus.- Strong programming skills in C, C++, and Python for embedded systems and automation scripting, with hands-on experience in microcontrollers, SoCs, low-level drivers, and various communication protocols (CAN, SPI, I2C, Ethernet, WiFi, BLE, Matter).- Proficient in designing scalable, modular, and secure embedded architectures for complex systems, complemented by strong software modeling skills, interface definition, and expertise in secure coding practices and product security standards.- Experienced with debugging tools, emulators, and performance optimization for resource-constrained systems, alongside familiarity with CI/CD pipelines for embedded development and version control systems (e.g., GitLab).- Ways of working- Proven track record in guiding agile and remote teams for embedded software projects, including defining KPIs, applying industry best practices, and introducing new tools and processes.- Strategic thinker with excellent communication skills and a customer-oriented mindset.- Languages: You are fluent in both spoken and written German and English.You are much more than your qualifications, and we believe in the potential of every single candidate. We look forward to getting to know you!Your individual personality and perspective are important to us. We create a working environment that reflects the diversity of the society and support you in your personal and professional development. Let’s get to know your authentic personality and create a better future together with us. As an equal-opportunity employer (https://www.siemens.com/de/de/unternehmen/jobs/arbeiten-bei-siemens/inklusion.html)  we are happy to consider applications from individuals with disabilities.About usAre you ready to shape the future of intelligent infrastructure?For us, it's all about integrating innovative electrical systems into buildings and infrastructures. To achieve this, the Siemens Smart Infrastructure Electrical Products team is constantly seeking pioneering technologies that are not only reliable and efficient, but also sustainable. Our mission is to make a tangible contribution to a sustainable future. Transform the everyday with us!You can find more information about the department and its products here:https://www.siemens.com/global/en/company/about/businesses/smart-infrastructure.html (https://www.siemens.com/global/en/company/about/businesses/smart-infrastructure.html)www.siemens.de/careers (http://www.siemens.com/de/en/company/jobs.html)  – if you would like to find out more about jobs & careers at Siemens.FAQ (http://www.siemens.com/de/de/unternehmen/jobs/karrieren-entdecken.html)  – if you need further information on the application process.

jobs.description: At JetBrains, code is our passion. Ever since we started, back in 2000, we have been striving to make the strongest, most effective developer tools on earth. About JetBrainsWe create intelligent software development tools for developers and teams. More than 15 million users, over 300,000 companies, and 88 of the Fortune Global Top 100 rely on our products to solve real, complex problems. Our mission is simple: make development teams more productive and AI adoptable at scale.What you’ll doWe build Qodana to bring the intelligence of JetBrains IDEs directly into the CI/CD pipeline, helping engineering teams spot security flaws, license issues, and bugs before they ever reach production. As AI-assisted coding grows, the need for deep, static code analysis is more critical than ever.In this role, you’ll join our Qodana Core team to expand our static analysis engine and design new algorithms for complex, inter-procedural code analysis. You will have direct ownership over how we configure and orchestrate these analyses across different environments. You’ll collaborate closely with other JetBrains compiler and IDE teams, directly influencing how development teams worldwide maintain code quality and adopt AI safely.Day to day, you will:- Design and implement new static analysis checks, rules, and inter-procedural analysis algorithms.- Extend Qodana’s capabilities in critical areas like license compliance, security, and vulnerability detection.- Optimize how code analysis runs, configure execution paths, and orchestrate performance based on project context.- Build and refine CI/CD integrations to make Qodana easy to adopt across different development workflows.- Collaborate with compiler and IDE teams across JetBrains to share insights and align analysis engines.- Take ownership of features from early concept to release, gathering feedback and iterating to make them better.What you’ll bring- A deep curiosity about code structure, compilers, and how static analysis works.- A proactive mindset, not waiting for permission to fix a broken process or improve a system.- Strong collaboration skills and a readiness to support your technical ideas with clear, logical reasoning.- Comfort working in a distributed team across different countries and time zones.- A focus on quality over quick fixes, valuing long-term maintainability in your work.- Experience with developer tooling, static analysis, application security, or LLM-based applications would be a plus. Familiarity with languages and ecosystems beyond the JVM – such as C++, Rust, JavaScript or TypeScript, Python, .NET, or Go – would also be valuable.What you’ll need- Deep, practical knowledge of JVM development (such as Kotlin or Java).- Experience designing and implementing complex algorithms or handling performance-critical backend architectures.- Fluent communication skills in English to collaborate with team members globally.What success looks like- **First 3 months:** You will get familiar with the Qodana codebase and the IntelliJ Platform architecture, delivering your first set of analysis rules and integrations.- **First 6 months:** You will take full ownership of specific analysis features, collaborating with neighboring teams to design robust solutions for complex codebases.- **Long term:** You will help shape the technical direction of Qodana Core, continuously raising the bar for static analysis performance and developer experience.Why join JetBrains?- Strong base salary – We offer competitive pay that reflects your skills and experience.- Flexible work schedule – Enjoy the freedom to work from home or from the office.- Extra time off – More days to relax, recharge, and do the things you love.- Learning and development opportunities – Access to conferences, courses, and language classes.- Relocation support – Assistance to help make your move as smooth and stress-free as possible.- Free meals and snacks – Lunch and refreshments provided to keep you fueled.- Health and wellness – On-site gyms or sports club stipends.- Internal events – Company-wide celebrations and team gatherings.We are an equal opportunity employer. We know great ideas can come from anyone, anywhere. That’s why we do our best to create an open and inclusive workplace – one that welcomes everyone regardless of their background, identity, religion, age, accessibility needs, or orientation.If this sounds like you, we’d love to hear from you.Ergänzende Informationen:Nur schwerbehinderte oder ihnen gleichgestellte PersonenHomeoffice:Umfang: Nach Vereinbarung
